You know...I like to believe that I'm a patient guy...and that I'm someone that honestly can get along with almost anyone. I know I have my faults and flaws...but, all in all...I like to at least pretend everything is ok...but, I know it isn't. My life has been a mess since the age of 7...and it has been for 14 years now. Somedays, I feel like I'm finally falling apart internally...other days, I have the strength to go on. I've been through a lot. Suicide attempts, betrayals by those close to me, having to suppress how I REALLY felt...all that without cracking at the slightest...and yet, as Time passes by...it only gets worse. It doesn't feel like I'm healing, but that more and more damage is just accumulating...and well, maybe it is. I just became an adult...I know I haven't lived out my whole life yet. It may get worse...but, for those who feel ready to give up...DON'T. Life is a shitshow, yeah...but we only get one of them, making them all the more precious. Whatever you are going through, you are not alone.
